full_judgment: 7. Mr. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record for the respondent, on the other hand, tried to support the judgment of the High Court Division submitting that the High Court Division rightly found that the appellant failed to prove bona fide requirement and as such the judgment of the High Court Division cannot be interfered with. He further submits that the appellant did not cause service of notice under Section 106 of the T.P. Act and as such the learned Judge of the High Court Division did not commit any illegality in finding that there was no discussion by the S.C.C. Judge about service of notice and that requirement for expansion of business was a mala fide one.
